name: Equity 3
definition: Financial instrument which represents a title of ownership in a company, ie, the shareholder is entitled to a part of the company's profit - usually by payment of a dividend - and to voting rights, if any. Each company issues generally different classes of shares, eg, ordinary or common shares, which have no guaranteed amount of dividend but carry voting rights, or preferred shares, which receive dividends before ordinary shares but have no voting right.

PreferenceToIncome.name: Preference To Income
PreferenceToIncome.definition: Indicates the level of priority to claim on income and assets of the company in case of the payment of dividends and in the event of a bankruptcy, for example, ordinary/common stocks, preferred stocks, subordinated debt, etc.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Date/time at which the security will no longer exist, for example, redeemable preference shares.

NonPaidAmount.name: Non Paid Amount
NonPaidAmount.definition: Nominal amount which is not paid yet.

ParValue.name: Par Value
ParValue.definition: Nominal value of an equity security.

VotingRightsPerShare.name: Voting Rights Per Share
VotingRightsPerShare.definition: Number of voting rights per share.
